render cold starts fix

Quick thread 🧵
> Render's free web services spin down after about 15 minutes without traffic and take roughly a minute to start on the next request; paid instances don't spin down.

So the fixes are: upgrade to a paid always-on instance, keep it warm with a scheduled ping (a band-aid that burns resources and doesn't help true first-time visitors), or move to a host that's always-on by default.
For anything customer-facing, always-on is the real answer, not a workaround.
